description_en: Modifies the attributes of a NAT gateway
description_zh: 调用ModifyNatGatewayAttribute接口修改NAT网关的属性
kebab_example: aliyun vpc modify-nat-gateway-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --nat-gateway-id ngw-2ze0dcn4mq31qx2jc0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyNatGatewayAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the NAT gateway that you want to modify. 

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
要修改的NAT网关所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the NAT gateway that you want to modify
parameters.name: nat_gateway_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the NAT gateway that you want to modify.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
要修改的NAT网关名称。

名称长度为1～128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the NAT gateway that you want to modify.

The description must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
要修改的NAT网关描述信息。

描述长度为1～128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable ICMP echo reply. Valid values:

true (default): Enabled.
false: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启ICMP代回。取值：

true（默认值）：开启。
false：不开启
parameters.name: icmp_reply_enabled

parameters.help_en:
The EIP attach pattern of the NAT gateway. Valid values: The value can be empty. If the value is not empty, only NAT is allowed, which indicates that the attach pattern is EIP Normal pattern.


You can only change the pattern from MULTI_BINDED to NAT. You cannot change the pattern from NAT to MULTI_BINDED. For more information about the MULTI_BINDED pattern, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120219.html.
During the EIP attach pattern switchover procedure, network connectivity may experience second-level transient connections (the transient connection duration increases as the number of EIPs increases. Currently, configuration changes are supported for NAT gateways with up to 5 EIPs attached). Execute the switchover during off-peak hours.
After the EIP attach pattern is changed to NAT, the Internet NAT gateway is compatible with the IPv4 gateway. However, attaching a public EIP occupies a private IP in the vSwitch where the NAT gateway resides. Make sure that sufficient private IP addresses are available in the vSwitch. If no available idle private IP addresses exist in the vSwitch, new EIPs cannot be attached
parameters.help_zh:
修改NAT网关的EIP绑定模式。取值：可以为空，非空时只允许为NAT，表示绑定模式为EIP普通模式。


只支持将MULTI_BINDED模式修改为NAT模式，不支持将NAT模式修改为MULTI_BINDED模式。关于MULTI_BINDED模式的具体信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120219.html。
在EIP绑定模式切换过程中网络连接会出现秒级别闪断（闪断时间随着EIP数量增加而变长，目前最多支持绑定5个EIP的NAT网关进行配置变更），请您尽量在业务低峰期执行切换操作。
EIP绑定模式变更为NAT后，公网NAT网关将兼容IPv4网关，但绑定一个公网EIP时将占用NAT网关所在交换机的一个私网IP，请确保NAT网关所在交换机内私网IP地址充足，如果NAT网关所在的交换机没有可用的空闲私网地址时，将无法绑定新的EIP
parameters.name: eip_bind_mode

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable session logging. Valid values:

true: Session logging is enabled.

false: Session logging is disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启会话日志，取值：

false：已关闭会话日志
parameters.name: enable_session_log
